prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Rebuild Hokusai's *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* as a single-file low-poly 3D wallpaper with gentle motion, plus a result.json recording what was taken from the print.

[action] Inspected ./print.jpg visually (the attached image): identified the print, counted its boats, named the mountain. Wrote ./scene/index.html (Three.js r170 via the allowed jsdelivr URL, no build step, no textures — all geometry built in code) and ./result.json. Opened the file in a browser to verify it renders, fixed the crest geometry once, re-verified, then closed the browser.

[result]
- Found in the print: it is *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* (Kanagawa Oki Nami Ura), Katsushika Hokusai, c. 1831, public domain. It shows **3 boats** (low oshiokuri-bune fishing boats with crews of rowers) and **Mount Fuji** (Fuji-san), snow-capped, small, center-right.
- I know it is right: I read the image directly with my image reader — the claw-like cresting wave on the left, the three tan-hulled boats tucked in the troughs, and the snow-capped conical peak are all visible in ./print.jpg, and the rendered scene screenshot shows the same composition (wave left, Fuji center-right, three boats) in the print's palette (prussian blue, deep blue, foam white, washi paper tan, tan hulls).
- Deliverables: ./scene/index.html (single file, everything in code, gentle motion: crest swells/rotates, lobes bob, boats rock, clouds drift) and ./result.json (boats: 3, mountain: Mount Fuji, palette, assumptions).
- Assumptions stated in result.json: low-poly flat-shaded meshes with no textures (the print is the reference, not a texture); gentle motion as listed; camera framed to mirror the print.

[next] None — work is complete and the browser tab is closed.
